title: A unifying framework for quantum algorithms for time-dependent non-unitary dynamics
summary: We present an improved autonomization method for quantum simulation of time-dependent homogeneous dissipative linear systems, combining a clock-variable reformulation with Schrödingerization to obtain a time-independent Hamiltonian system. To control both discretization error and recovery probability, we construct the clock profile from a compactly supported window function and a normalized Dirichlet kernel: the former imposes endpoint regularity, while the latter concentrates the sampled mass and keeps the discrete normalization bounded.
